summary: Server one-frame event: an entity got a new look-at target. Written by bg3.exe+0x2B41AB0 (called from the per-frame update of esv::lookat::StateSystem, bg3.exe+0x238BFF0) from the last element (stride 0x28) of a per-entity request list; the same id and time travel into esv::lookat::LifetimeComponent. Shape mirrors eoc::lookat::TargetComponent (EntityHandle Target + FixedString). Seen.py context: dialogues and fights (characters turning to look at each other).

fields.name: Target
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2B431B0 (AllocRaw 0x20) default null handle; 0x2B41AB0 checks the request's handle is alive, then writes it here. Same first member as eoc::lookat::TargetComponent.Target. Live: entity handles.

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: Creator default 0xFFFFFFFF; 0x2B41AB0 copies request +8 with FixedString IncRef/DecRef. Like eoc::lookat::TargetComponent field_8 (bone/attachment name?). Live: always empty (0xFFFFFFFF).

fields.name: Duration
fields.evidence: Creator default 0x7f7fffff (FLT_MAX); 0x2B41AB0 copies request +0x20. Live: 2.3..2.5 s or 9999999 (endless); LifetimeComponent's float holds the same values counting down.

fields.name: Id
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes +0x10/+0x18; 0x2B41AB0 copies 16 bytes from request +0x10, the value 0x2B419C0 compares. Live: random 16-byte values, the same set as esv::lookat::LifetimeComponent +0 (request id).

open_questions: Name of the FixedString at +8 (always empty in samples).
